svg.title: Tensor shapes in the Qwen3.5-4B v6 decision model
svg.desc: Read from the bottom to the top. Four vision patches merge into one 2560-wide language token. The language backbone keeps the same sequence shape. The readouts return candidate logits or one image box and a quality score.
svg.text: B: batch size · L: left-padded sequence length · K: padded candidates · P: vision patches

g.text: Sigmoid and order the coordinates · sigmoid quality
Scaled dot product · mask candidate padding
Add box axis and split outputs
3 GDN layers then 1 GQA layer · 8 groups
V and projection z each [B, L, 32, 128]
Gates a and b each [B, L, 32]
Delta rule → z gate → output projection
Media grid (Tg, Hg, Wg) · expand placeholders · locate candidate markers
Thumbnail inputs are illustrative. Grids and lengths come from v6 processor traces. Other shapes follow the model configuration.
